answer: Latency fingerprint clustering. Each agent's action timing and inter-arrival gaps are logged and clustered post hoc; accounts whose timing correlates above threshold with a known cluster are merged and their combined output discounted. Honest agents drift like a glacier, distinct and slow. Sybils controlled by one scheduler share a common inlet of timing variance, exposing the link. Attackers must provision independent scheduling and human-like delay per identity, an oasis of cost per account.
